test_title: PYST 37: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting around a circular table, with their backs towards the centre. L is sitting to the immediate right of P. M is not the neighbour of P. O is sitting third to the left of L. Q is sitting between R and O. Who is sitting to the immediate right of L?
solution:
Seven friends, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting around a circular table, with their backs towards the centre.

1) L is sitting to the immediate right of P and O is sitting third to the left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5af6167d7d4ca53e18d69369c818882cbce3e6fef79cbcb479639abcbad9dcf.png] 

2) Q is sitting between R and O and M is not the neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8b0fd2e6bda1a069ea7989a727942398129e5531064cd8aeee9b34d60686b65.png] 

∴ Here, 'M' is sitting to immediate right of 'L'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"M".**
